videos.title: THE SHADOW v1
videos.signature: shadow_homothety — the villain is the hero's own lamp-cast shadow, computed physically (k = D/(D−d)); a distance readout is the spine (7.4 → 10.3 → -- → 1.8 → 9.9 → --); carrying the light forward puts the shadow on the floor behind him
callbacks: lantern: lit (3.3 s) → out (39.5) → relit (57) → carried (126) → set at the wall (136) → out (143)
red whispers: stay. / not yet. / what if. → turn back. (climax) → gone after the wall
corner: hides small (S04) → sits beside the light, same corner wall (S18)
quotable_lines: You can't measure what you won't look at.
Fear is a shadow. Walk toward it — and it is exactly your size.

videos.title: THE WINDOW v1
videos.signature: window_mirror — the villain is a real facade of 31 lit windows (measured rects); four red lines on the glass get four white answers in the same positions; the phone dies and the hero's reflection is laid over all 31 windows; the clock stops at 88.0 and never ticks again; the first amber light in the film is his own lamp; DAY 40 somebody across the street looks up at a new window (Picardy third D minor → D major)
videos.hook_text: 11:48 PM — It's eleven forty-eight at night. He's lying in the dark, and his face is glowing blue.
callbacks: 'You only ever see the lit room.' — narration at 49.1 → final card at 146.9
red lines → white answers in the same glass positions: he's ahead → he's hurting · they're happy → they're quiet · you're late → it's two a.m. · look at them → look at you
31 windows counted at 7.0 → 'his own reflection, laid over all thirty-one of them' at 83.6 → 31 silhouettes looking back at 127.0
the three windows return as his days: DAY 1 he is the runner · DAY 23 the couple sees him pass · DAY 40 the man with two monitors looks up
his window: blue flicker (12.6) → dark (74.9) → amber (121.3) → amber wide (138.4)
quotable_lines: Every window you have ever envied has someone standing in it, looking at yours.
The only window you will ever see from the inside is your own.

videos.title: TUMHARI RESERVED SEAT · WF-03 · unnumbered 16:9 final
videos.signature: thirty_punches — every delayed choice punches a physical hole in the same ticket; the holes become a thirty-hour constellation, then align into the lit windows of the train that is still waiting
videos.hook_text: A ticket printer wakes in an empty station: EK BURI KHABAR — RESERVED SEAT EXPIRES.
callbacks: 11:47 station clock returns when the proof/lucky board splits
empty reserved seat returns occupied by the hero at the final line
20-minute punched ticket returns as the action ticket
thirty punched holes become thirty train windows
cold fluorescent world receives its first amber practical only when the hero starts
quotable_lines: Sapne expire nahi hote, magar unki seat reserve bhi nahi rehti.
Seat tumhari hai. Train abhi platform par hai.
